---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a new command, hook, agent, skill or change in behavior
labels: enhancement
---

Read [`docs/reference/PHILOSOPHY.md`](../../docs/reference/PHILOSOPHY.md) first, especially the rejection list, and check [`docs/reference/roadmap.md`](../../docs/reference/roadmap.md) to see if it is already planned. A request that breaks a principle will be closed.

## What problem does it solve

Describe the real session, error or workflow that hit this. "It could be cleaner" is not a problem.

## What you propose

One sentence on the change, then the details.

## Prior art

Which existing tool already does this? The kit adds a component only when it traces to a proven pattern elsewhere. Name the source.

## What you tried instead

Existing commands, hooks or config you used, and why they fell short.
